title: Detroit Downtown Food Tour with 6+ Iconic Tastings in Motor City
blurb: Dive into Detroit’s downtown soul on a flavorful walking food tour guided by genuine city storytellers. Explore the heart of Motor City—from Greektown to historic landmarks—as you enjoy 6+ iconic tastings that tell the story of Detroit’s culinary comeback. Indulge in corned beef egg rolls, sample rival Coney Island hot dogs, cool off with a Detroit original Boston Cooler float, savor a slice of Detroit-style pizza, treat yourself to a Greektown pastry, and uncover our chef’s exclusive Secret Dish with a local twist. Every stop pairs delicious bites with compelling stories—from immigrant roots to renaissance neighborhoods—offering a warm and authentic taste of Detroit you won’t find on your own.
